newsitem.title: USA: Outlook Group Q2 oper loss narrowed.
newsitem.headline: Outlook Group Q2 oper loss narrowed.

text.p: Outlook Group Corp cited operating controls, efficiencies and continued reduction in overhead as factors that helped narrow its operating loss for the second quarter ended November 29.
It posted an operating loss of $0.08 per share compared to a year-ago operating loss of $0.14 per share.

In September, the graphic services and packaging company, disclosed plans to divest Outlook Foods and its Barrier Films Corp subsidiaries. Chairman David Erdmann said there has been a strong interest in the two operations by prospective purchasers.
